title: Mobile Device Management
scenario: You are enabling hybrid device management for domain-joined Windows devices by using Hybrid Azure AD Join and Microsoft Intune. Complete the activities below to demonstrate the correct sequence for SCP configuration, automatic enrollment, compliance configuration, and management validation.

activities.prompt: Arrange the following steps in the correct order to configure Hybrid Azure AD Join by using Azure AD Connect.
steps: Open Azure AD Connect and choose Configure
Choose Configure Hybrid Azure AD Join
Publish the Service Connection Point and complete the wizard
answer: Open Azure AD Connect and choose Configure
Choose Configure Hybrid Azure AD Join
Publish the Service Connection Point and complete the wizard

activities.prompt: Select the Intune setting that must be configured to enable automatic enrollment for users.
Match each configuration area to its purpose in hybrid device management.
right: Allows domain-joined devices to discover Microsoft Entra registration settings
Defines device health and security requirements
answers: Allows domain-joined devices to discover Microsoft Entra registration settings
Defines device health and security requirements

activities.prompt: Select the validation checks used to confirm successful Hybrid Azure AD Join and Intune enrollment.
options: Review device registration locally on the client
Confirm the device appears in Microsoft Entra ID
Confirm the device appears in Intune
Create a dynamic DNS update rule
answer: Review device registration locally on the client
Confirm the device appears in Microsoft Entra ID
Confirm the device appears in Intune

activities.prompt: Complete the command used on a Windows client to review local device registration state.
Arrange the management tasks in the correct order after enrollment is working.
